crew.overview: A psychopathic criminal with a mother complex makes a daring break from prison and then leads his old gang in a chemical plant payroll heist. After the heist, events take a crazy turn.
crew.title: White Heat

details.biography:
​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.  

Virginia Kellogg (December 3, 1907 – April 8, 1981) was a film writer whose scripts for White Heat (1949) and Caged (1950) were nominated for Oscars.

At one time, she was married to director Frank Lloyd.
